decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location plan, Proposed layout drawing, existing plan, Received 29/10/2013 and email from agent re proposed use of the site dated 16/12/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 08.00 to 20.00 Monday to Sunday.
Condition : 4 - No amplified music shall be played in the premises at any time
Condition : 5 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Change of use of property from A2 (financial) to A1/A3 (mixed use retail and caf?) (no external alterations)
